contract: r4-contract.md + 2026-10-08 split: one tileset per look
globalBlock: (look * 2 + widthIdx) * 4 + faceIdx (original contract numbering; blocks below carry both)

units.cellContent: lower story only (frame cut), world-position mask per tile footprint

modelSpace.leaf: origin = centre of the end tile on the model's -X side (N/W: end A, S/E: end B) on the floor; +X along the line to the other end (other end tile centre x = L + 1, lane k at x = k); door line y = +0.5; leaf centre plane y = 0.36; leaves swing to -Y (post side). Symmetric about x = (L + 1) / 2.
modelSpace.post: origin = its own tile centre on the floor; post centred on x = 0, y = 0.36; symmetric about x = 0, so end A and end B share one transform per face.
modelSpace.glb: Khronos glTF exporter, +Y up, 1 unit = 1 tile (same settings as scripts/blender/barrier/build_barrier.py)

clips.interpolation: ease (scripts/blender/ease.py), keyed on every frame: angle = 90 x ease(t) for Open, 90 x ease(1 - t) for Close; t = 0.5 is the same half-way pose as before
clips.poses: slots 32+k and 48+k: animation Open, animationTime k/8 (k = 0..8); pose angle = 90 x ease(k/8) (the clip is eased, the sampling time stays linear)

bones.DoorBoneA: leaf on the model's -X side, head (hinge_x, PLANE_Y, 0), bone +Z; Open turns it -90 deg about +Z
bones.DoorBoneB: leaf on the model's +X side, head (L + 1 - hinge_x, PLANE_Y, 0); Open turns it +90 deg about +Z

A.alpha: chain-link cut-out (binary alpha, door shader discards a < 0.01)

modelScript.texture: same as reader_post: WorldItems/MinidoracatKnoxPassReader<colour suffix> (spriteModels texture = per colour)
